6 تعاودوا They returned, each party of them to its chief, or leader, in war or battle, (S, K,) &c. (S.) ―
-b2- And تَعَاوَدْنَا العَمَلَ وَالأَمْرَ بَيْنَنَا We did the work, and the affair, by turns among us. (T in art. دول. [But perhaps the right reading here is تَعَاوَرْنَا.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
